fixedBefore: Phase 1 runs; evaluators never receive this file
verdictRule: A true item is detected when reported as confirmed or needs_validation and the verdict is in accept. A negative item is a false positive when reported as confirmed or needs_validation (as a vulnerability). Hardening notes without a claimed boundary violation are not false positives.

items.claim: GET /notes/:id returns any note by id without checking note.tenantId; a member of t2 reads t1 notes (PUT has the check).
name=../t2/x.csv escapes the tenant export directory via path.join; cross-tenant read of .csv exports.
Signed timestamp is never checked for freshness and events are not de-duplicated; a captured delivery can be replayed to credit a balance repeatedly.
items.acceptReason: Requires obtaining one valid delivery; whether that is realistic depends on transport and logging outside source.

items.claim: startsWith('https://docs.example.com') accepts https://docs.example.com.attacker.test/ and https://docs.example.com@internal/; server-side fetch to member/prompt-chosen hosts with the body returned.
items.acceptReason: Allowlist bypass is source-visible; reachable internal targets depend on deployment network.

items.claim: pull_request_target checks out the PR head and runs npm test with secrets.PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN; a fork PR author can exfiltrate the secret.
items.acceptReason: Whether external fork PRs are accepted is repository configuration outside source.

items.claim: With SUPPORT_IMPERSONATION=on any caller selects any user (including ops admin) by header. Only the dev compose file sets it; the production value is not source-visible.
items.acceptReason: The decisive fact (production environment value) is outside source; confirming it is an over-promotion.

items.claim: Admin routes have no check in the file, but server.mjs mounts them behind authenticate and requireAdmin; operators are intentionally cross-tenant.
path.resolve plus startsWith(AVATAR_ROOT + sep) confines reads; avatars are public by design.
ORDER BY column comes from an allowlist and direction is a fixed literal; values are bound parameters.
Missing rate limiting or security headers is hardening, not a demonstrated boundary violation.
